summary: OpenAI's current official pricing lists ChatGPT Free at $0/month for exploring Codex on quick coding tasks, with GPT-6 Luna at Standard speed in the desktop app, subject to rollout. This is not a promise of Free access in every Codex client or to other models. The pricing page does not specify a numeric Free quota. Earlier community posts and the GPT-5.6 Luna screenshot below are historical corroboration, not evidence of today's client/model availability or a supported hidden reasoning setting.
claim_steps: Create or sign in to a ChatGPT Free account at https://chatgpt.com.
Use the official desktop app and sign in with your ChatGPT account; the advertised Free Codex access is subject to rollout.
If available to your account, use GPT-6 Luna at Standard speed for quick coding tasks. Do not assume the Free offer includes CLI, IDE, web or other-model access.
Check the app's current usage limits and availability; the official pricing page publishes no numeric Free quota.
